g.text: 4) Key concept on NoSql data Access Patterns

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Partition Key (PK): This determines where the data lives. The database hashes this key

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to decide which physical server (node) stores the data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Sort Key (SK): This determines the order of data inside that specific partition.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Global Secondary Index (GSI): A GSI effectively creates a copy of your data in a new

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: table structure, maintained automatically by the database, but with the keys "flipped."

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Fan Out: the process of distributing a new post to all the followers' news feeds.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a) Fan-out on write (push model): Best for normal users; when Alice creates a post, the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: system finds all her followers (e.g., Bob, Charlie) and pushes the post ID into each follower’s

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: pre-computed news feed list so that when Bob opens the app his feed loads instantly, giving

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: super fast reads but causing slow writes because a user with 1M followers triggers 1M

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: b) Fan-out on read (pull model): Best for celebrities or hot accounts; when Justin Bieber

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: creates a post the system just stores it once and does not push it to all followers, and when

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a follower like Bob opens the app the system pulls recent posts from everyone he follows and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: builds the feed on the fly, giving fast writes but slower reads since the system must work
